title: test(spec): eight scripts/ test-budget rows -- three trimmed, five declare their measured CI budget
body:
Part of #23180
Clause-②: no

The eight `packages/spec/scripts/` rows of the test-budget census, measured first. Three rows are trimmed in the test (every `expect` line unchanged). Five rows spawn the real producer once per single-cause fixture, so each carries its measured `// test-budget:` line under ruling record `6181973363`. This PR counts no row off the card: the next refresh list decides each one.

## Current CI readings (executed hourly runs, not replays)

Read from the `Test Core (1/6)` shard logs of the three hourly schedule runs on 2026-10-15 whose aggregator lists `@objectstack/spec` as "measured here" (it is in none of their cache-replayed lists): `38702741098` (08:01, head `f7cd580bff`), `38731551915` (12:01, head `57994c311f`), `38798542648` (20:01, head `9e0945cf45`). The newest run, `38814162165` (22:01), replayed spec and is not used. Seconds, vitest module line:

| file | project | 08:01 | 12:01 | 20:01 | verdict |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| `dist-freshness-adoption.test.ts` | repo | 56.7 | 71.3 | 71.4 | (b) declared 90 |
| `def-key-collisions.test.ts` | repo | 37.6 | 47.4 | 51.3 | (b) declared 70 |
| `strictness-ledger-doc.test.ts` | repo | 32.1 | 39.1 | 43.9 | (a) trimmed |
| `openapi-self-consistency.test.ts` | local | 37.9 | 45.2 | 48.6 | (a) trimmed |
| `dist-freshness.test.ts` | repo | 18.1 | 23.1 | 24.2 | (b) declared 40 |
| `upgrade-guide-docs.test.ts` | local | 15.1 | 19.1 | 19.7 | (b) declared 30 |
| `conversions-major18-merge.test.ts` | repo | 10.2 | 14.0 | 16.8 | (a) trimmed |
| `projection-cli.test.ts` | local | 9.4 | 11.6 | 11.6 | (b) declared 20 |

Every row is still over 10 s in at least two of the three runs, so none had dropped off since the card's refresh run `38340176409`.

## (a) Trimmed: what each one waited on

- **`strictness-ledger-doc.test.ts`**: eleven cases each called `loadLedger`, which parses every `*.zod.ts` under `src/` into a TypeScript AST (about 400 ms locally per call). `loadLedger` is a pure read of the checkout and no case writes to what it returns, so the file now loads it once (`treeLedger()`). The independent `analyzeTree` walk in "measures the same tree the AST counter does" stays its own walk.
- **`conversions-major18-merge.test.ts`**: `entriesOf` and `definitionsOf` ran `maskComments` over the 750 KB `src/conversions/registry.ts` about 55 times (about 40 ms per pass, measured), re-deriving the same dozen texts. The mask is a pure function of its input, so the file now masks each distinct text once (`maskOnce`, keyed by the text).
- **`openapi-self-consistency.test.ts`**: nine spawns of the real `build-openapi.ts`, five of them the identical unmutated run and two the identical dangling-component-ref mutation. Each distinct fixture is now generated once and read by the cases that assert on it (4 spawns). The spawn calls the package's own `node_modules/.bin/tsx`, the same binary `npx tsx` finds in the sandbox, without npx's own start-up: `build-openapi.ts` ran in 1342 / 1399 / 1519 ms through npx against 886 / 811 / 924 ms direct.

Local module line, interleaved runs under `os-verify-lock.sh`, BASE `534ca13eb` against `d2790bd96` (shared-box seconds):

| file | before (ms) | after (ms) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `strictness-ledger-doc` | 5450 / 5145 / 5413 | 975 / 960 / 1053 |
| `openapi-self-consistency` | 11587 / 10687 / 10898 | 3465 / 3479 / 3871 |
| `conversions-major18-merge` | 2778 / 2872 / 3036 | 1150 / 1303 / 1231 |

At each file's own CI-to-local ratio (8.3x, 4.1x, 5.9x; slowest CI reading over the first local before-reading), the after-readings project to about 8 s, 15 s and 7 s in the battery. That is NOT MEASURED on CI. `openapi-self-consistency` is projected to stay over 10 s. Its remaining floor is four single-cause spawns of the real producer, one of the ruled classes, so if the next refresh still lists it, its declaration follows with the post-trim CI reading. This PR does not declare it with the pre-trim number.

## (b) Declared: the floor is one producer spawn per single-cause fixture

Per-case local readings show where each file's time goes. Each number is the slowest of the three CI readings above x 1.25, rounded up to the next 10 s:

| file | where the time goes (local) | arithmetic |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `dist-freshness-adoption` | all 10 cases, one spawn each of a real dist-reading gate in its own sandbox (0.74 to 2.31 s per case) | 71.362 x 1.25 = 89.2, so 90 |
| `def-key-collisions` | one case, 8425 of 8430 ms: the real schema generator on a sandbox copy of `src` with the one re-declared def key | 51.268 x 1.25 = 64.1, so 70 |
| `dist-freshness` | 4 spawn cases, 4531 of 4595 ms: 5 runs of the real `build-api-surface.ts` | 24.165 x 1.25 = 30.2, so 40 |
| `upgrade-guide-docs` | 4 spawn cases, 7077 of 7106 ms: 9 runs of the real `build-upgrade-guide.ts` | 19.673 x 1.25 = 24.6, so 30 |
| `projection-cli` | 4 spawn cases, 4790 of 4819 ms: 6 runs of the two real projection generators | 11.642 x 1.25 = 14.6, so 20 |

What one spawn costs, measured locally: a bare `tsx -e 1` takes 424 to 587 ms, and a `build-upgrade-guide.ts` usage error that exits 2 before writing anything takes 733 to 901 ms, which is about the same as a full `--check` (805 to 914 ms). The cost is tsx start-up plus importing the registries, and generation itself is negligible. The sandbox copies are not the cost either: `fs.cpSync` of `scripts/` takes 4 to 14 ms, and of `src/` 101 to 379 ms.

Each line is at line 2, under the copyright line, as the four declarations on `main` are. `readTestBudget` and `declaredBudgetInTree('@objectstack/spec', FILE)` from `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs` read 90, 70, 40, 30 and 20, and `null` for the three trimmed files. Two controls are refused: a misspelled class ("the class ... is neither class the ruling names") and a 15 s budget ("not on the 10 s grid").

## Ablations: the trimmed paths still go red

All three ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. Expected direction: red. Observed: red. Each restore was proven (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), and the tree was clean after. No `dist/` is in any path: tsx and vitest read source.

- **A1**, `scripts/build-openapi.ts` without its `BaseResponse` component: blob `04db95741ff4` to `be6bcfae2f9c`. 3 of 21 failed, including both shared-run cases ("emits all nine components": expected output to contain `Components: 9`; "writes a document whose components are complete": length 9, got 8). The second shared case took 6 ms, which shows it read the shared run.
- **A2**, the `ui/` posture row in `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/ui.md` edited: blob `a95f31caf2ce` to `5ddf40dc3f32`. 2 of 24 failed: "is checked in current" and "the read-time totals equal the sums of the shards' own rows" (`[478, 352, 6, 1, 119]` against `[478, 353, 6, 1, 118]`). Both read the memoised ledger.
- **A3**, two adjacent `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` entries swapped in `src/conversions/registry.ts`: blob `3e1bfb1b04f9` to `e3de633149bf`. 4 of 12 failed, including "the entries are kept SORTED by identifier", all through the memoised mask.

## Verification

- Final head `c0ca73fd2` (merged with `origin/main` `3b46855fb`, spec rebuilt): all eight files pass. Tests per file: 10, 17, 24, 21, 24, 15, 12 and 12, 135 in all.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` at `c0ca73fd2`: VERDICT command-exit 0. The eight files are compiled by `tsconfig.scripts.json` (`check:scripts-typecheck`), which lists 8 of 8.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `c0ca73fd2` derived 59 commands. All ran, each exit recorded before any pipe. `--ran` reports "59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 57 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". The two are `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because the dist of other packages was not built here. Neither reads a test file under `packages/spec/scripts/`. CI runs both.
- No publish: `npm pack --dry-run` of `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.1 lists 2092 files, with 0 under `scripts/`, 0 `*.test.ts` and none of the eight. Positive controls `src/data/field.zod.ts` and `dist/index.js` are present. So `skip-changeset`.
- Local test scope: only the eight changed files ran here. The diff is test files only, and no other test imports them. CI's `Test Core` runs both spec projects.

## Acceptance notes

- Two declared rows from the earlier round read above their budgets in executed run `38798542648`: `build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` read 983.27 s against its declared 940 s, and `check-liveness.test.ts` read 425.63 s against its declared 410 s. In run `38731551915` they read 925.47 s and 402.21 s. Neither file is in this round. The next refresh's list decides whether either needs a re-measured line.
- `def-key-collisions.test.ts` still spawns through `npx tsx`, which costs about 0.5 s of its 8.4 s locally. It is left unchanged, so the declared number is measured on the code it is declared for.
- The vitest module line excludes the file's import time. For example, `conversions-major18-merge`'s module line was 2866 ms beside an import of 3.38 s in the same run. The census and these budgets measure the module line only.
